topic: Negotiating the rent renewal with comps vs signing the increase (Milo vs Greta)

scenes.narration: One awkward email saved her fifteen hundred dollars this year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled SIGN IT and NEGOTIATE IT, comic burst banner reads FIFTEEN HUNDRED SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Milo and Greta rent identical units and pay sixteen hundred monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man milo and woman greta outside matching apartment doors, a sign stamped SIXTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both renewal letters demand an eight percent increase next year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, milo and greta each holding a letter stamped EIGHT PERCENT INCREASE, a gym chalkboard behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Milo signs immediately, assuming the number simply cannot be negotiated.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, milo signing a lease on a gym bench, a wall poster reads TAKE IT OR LEAVE IT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His rent jumps to seventeen hundred twenty eight dollars monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, milo straining under a barbell plate stamped SEVENTEEN HUNDRED TWENTY EIGHT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Greta researches three comparable listings renting for sixteen hundred nearby.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, greta at a gym whiteboard pinning three listing printouts each labeled SIXTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She emails her manager: perfect payment record, two year tenant.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, greta typing at a gym office desk beside a folder stamped PERFECT PAYMENT RECORD TWO YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She offers to sign eighteen months at the current rent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, greta sliding a contract labeled EIGHTEEN MONTHS AT SIXTEEN HUNDRED across a desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Turnover costs landlords thousands, so the manager accepts her offer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a landlord stamping greta's contract APPROVED, a chart on the wall labeled TURNOVER COSTS THOUSANDS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Milo pays fifteen hundred thirty six dollars extra this year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, milo slumped beside a gym scoreboard reading FIFTEEN HUNDRED THIRTY SIX EXTRA, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Greta's rent stayed flat and she gained eighteen months certainty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, greta flexing beside a flat line chart labeled RENT UNCHANGED and a calendar stamped EIGHTEEN MONTHS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Email your landlord with comps before you ever renew. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading BRING COMPS THEN ASK, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
